text: This report recommends approving an agreement with G4S Secure Solutions (Canada) Ltd. for the non-exclusive provision of road closure and vehicle marshalling security services for a one-year term with 3 one-year options to renew. This recommendation follows the competitive process undertaken by the City of Toronto Purchasing and Materials Management Division.

The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Approved an agreement with G4S Secure Solutions (Canada) to provide road closure and vehicle marshalling services, as required, on the terms and conditions set out in the report (September 6, 2018) from the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place and such other terms and conditions required by the Chief Executive Officer and the City Solicitor.
